player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} playing a game of Checkers as {color}.
Make your move in chess-style notation [fileRank fileRank], e.g. '[b2c3]' (column letter a–h, row digit 0–7).
Basic rules:
  • Move diagonally forward by 1 if empty.
  • Capture by jumping over an opponent piece.
  • A piece is Kinged if it reaches the opposite end.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Anggapoy nalmoan ya valid move format. Use [a1b2], eg [b2c3].

outcome.red_no_pieces: Anggapo lay atilak a piraso na Red. Manalo so Black!
outcome.black_no_pieces: Anggapo lay atilak a piraso na andeket. Manalo so ambalanga!
outcome.no_moves: Anggapo lay atilak a galaw na manlalako {player_id}.
outcome.draw: Akasabi la so limitasyon na kalkalnan iyalis.
